summary: Focused claim o-8a5ef82f8ac10713, anchored to g0006: the old harness cannot exercise string type validation for an object member on either source version.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions support rejecting a non-string object member selected by the string unpack format. A finite input containing {"data":1} reaches object-member unpacking, but the fixed harness selects the generic o format for that member. Its other unpack calls provide no equivalent string-member validation.

before.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string value format rejects a selected non-string member.
before.reason: Object-member lookup delegates to format-specific unpacking, where s rejects a non-string value. The harness instead uses {s?o} for data.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object-member lookup passes the selected value to the format-specific unpacker.

after.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string value format rejects a selected non-string member.
after.reason: The string type check remains supported, while the same harness still selects o for data.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object-member lookup still passes the selected value to the format-specific unpacker.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzzer bytes provide the JSON object passed to unpacking.

claims.comparison_reason: The fixed {s?o} member format prevents string type validation on both sides. The g0006 change to error wording does not change that constraint.
